title: Finite split etale diagrams before covering descent
statement: A truncated finite split etale diagram has the same simplicial, nondegenerate, finite component, and matching data as def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover, with qcqs matching objects and without requiring matching maps to be surjective. Its pullback is defined explicitly and its matching universal property is transported through the map-pullback adjunction. The notions used here are those of [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover], [def-weil-pbc-truncated-etale-matching-data], [def-weil-pbc-truncated-finite-split-etale-splitting].

source.place: Detailed form proof: finite simplicial data and finite matching limits

proof.text: Attach finite matching data to a specified splitting. A summand is a singleton finite component. Pull back simplicial objects, finite summands, splitting coproducts and matching objects. Finite coproducts of schemes are universal; the map-pullback adjunction transports the matching universal property. Once the matching maps are surjective the original hypercover structure is recovered.
